author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: सृष्टौ प्रकृतेरनुक्तेः साधनानि विनैव सृष्टिं करोतीति प्रतीतिनिरासायोक्तं विवृणोति ॥  प्रकृतिमिति ।  स्वां स्वाधीनां प्रकृतिं त्रिगुणात्मिकामवष्टभ्य उपादानतयाऽऽश्रित्य प्रकृतेर्-वशात्तदधीनत्वादवशं स्वानधीनम् ।  यद्वा मदधीनप्रकृति-वशत्वादेवाकारवाच्यब्रह्मरूपमदधीनं इमं कृत्स्नं भूतग्रामं पुनः पुनः विसृजामि ।  प्रकृत्यादिसाधनावष्टंभो न तेन विना स्रष्टुमसामर्थ्यात् ।  किंतु लीलयैव ।  प्रकृत्यादेः ।  साधनताशक्ते-र्मदायत्तत्वादिति ज्ञापनाय स्वामिति विशेषणोक्तिः ।  तदुक्तं तदनन्यत्वनये 'ॐ युक्तेः शब्दांतराच्च ॐ' (२.१.१९) इति सुत्रे ॥ ९.८॥
translation: Making use of My own Prakriti, I again and again bring out the whole of this multitude of beings which are under the power of Prakriti. (8.) V. My own: Subject to My control. Prakriti: which is composed of the three principles of matter, Satva, &c. Making use of, &c., making Prakriti the material cause of My creation. Which are under the power of Prakriti; all the being are also controlled by Myself; for the very power of Prakriti overwhelming other natures is under My direction and control. The word Avasa has two meanings (1) not having self-control; (2) (A: Vishnu; vasa: control) one that is under the control of Vishnu. Because the Lord makes use of Prakriti in His creation, it should not be supposed that He is unable to work without Prakriti. On the other hand, it is His Supreme grace and sport to use it. Hence the epithet Svâm (My own) is added to show that the virtue in Prakriti to become the means is in the gift and guidance of the Lord. (Vide Sutra.) (8) A. In creating the various things does the Lord become bound by any Karma as the Jiva is by his actions? “No,” Sri Krishna says:
